# Fort Pitt Classic Cars (concept by Kerblabs)

> One-stop classic car shop in Pittsburgh, PA. Facts from fortpittclassiccars.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Location: Pittsburgh, PA (street address not published on the source page)
- Website: https://fortpittclassiccars.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fortpittclassiccars/

## Services
- Classic car restoration
- Classic car sales
- Service, maintenance and upgrades
- Storage
- Detailing
- Speed shop performance modifications
- Appraisals and acquisition assistance

## Hours (as listed on their site)
- Sales: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Sat by appointment
- Service: Tue-Fri 8am-4pm
- Consultation: Mon-Fri 9am-4pm, weekends by appointment
